vitamins.name: Thiamine
vitamins.summary: Essential cofactor for central carbon metabolism (pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, transketolase). Formed by coupling of thiazole and pyrimidine moieties followed by phosphorylation.

steps.name: Sulfur carrier protein complex (ThiF+ThiS)
steps.note: Low specificity; shares homology with moeB/moaD molybdenum systems.

reasons: Lacks ThiC pyrimidine synthesis but retains ThiG thiazole synthesis and ThiE coupling (HMP-dependent)
Lacks ThiG thiazole synthesis but retains ThiC pyrimidine synthesis, ThiE coupling and ThiM salvage (HET-dependent)

vitamins.name: Riboflavin
vitamins.summary: Precursor of flavin mononucleotide (FMN) and flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD), fundamental electron carriers in redox biology. Synthesized from GTP and ribulose 5-phosphate.

steps.name: GTP cyclohydrolase II (RibA)
steps.note: K14652 is the bifunctional RibBA enzyme common in Bacillus and Gram-positive bacteria.

steps.name: Pyrimidine deaminase (RibD)
steps.note: K11752 is the fused deaminase/reductase enzyme.

steps.name: ArPP phosphatase
steps.note: Often performed by non-specific haloacid dehalogenase (HAD) phosphatases; never penalized.

pathways.name: Riboflavin activation to FMN and FAD

vitamins.name: Niacin / NAD
vitamins.summary: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD) is the principal hydride donor/acceptor in cellular bioenergetics. Synthesized de novo via aspartate or tryptophan, or reclaimed via salvage.

reasons: Lacks quinolinate de novo route but retains NadD, NadE, and salvage enzyme PncB/NadV/NadR (niacin/NR-dependent)

vitamins.name: Pantothenate
vitamins.summary: Precursor of Coenzyme A, the universal carrier of activated acyl groups. Formed by the condensation of pantoate and beta-alanine.

steps.name: Branched-chain amino acid aminotransferase (IlvE)
steps.note: Shared with branched amino acid biosynthesis.

steps.name: 2-dehydropantoate 2-reductase (PanE)
steps.note: Ketol-acid reductoisomerase IlvC (K00053) often substitutes; never penalized.

vitamins.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
vitamins.summary: Principal coenzyme for transaminases, decarboxylases, and racemases. Synthesized either via DXP-dependent pathway (E. coli-like) or DXP-independent PdxST complex (Bacillus-like).

steps.name: D-erythrose 4-phosphate dehydrogenase (Epd)
steps.note: Can be substituted by glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GapA); never penalized.

steps.name: Phosphoserine aminotransferase (SerC)
steps.note: Low specificity; primary role in serine biosynthesis.

steps.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate synthase complex (PdxS + PdxT)
steps.note: Complex of glutaminase (PdxT) and synthase (PdxS). Both subunits required.

vitamins.name: Biotin
vitamins.summary: Cofactor for carboxylase enzymes. Composed of an imidazolidone ring, tetrahydrothiophene ring, and valeric acid side chain. Formed by pimeloyl precursor supply followed by core assembly.

pathways.name: Biotin biosynthesis (BioI cytochrome P450 pimeloyl route)

reasons: Core biotin assembly genes (BioF, BioA, BioD, BioB) are present; pimeloyl supply may use an unannotated or alternative route.
Lacks early biotin genes but retains BioB (desthiobiotin-dependent)

vitamins.name: Folate / THF
vitamins.summary: Crucial cofactor transferring one-carbon units in purine, thymidylate, methionine, and pantothenate synthesis. Requires pterin moiety, p-aminobenzoate (pABA), and glutamate.

steps.name: Dihydroneopterin triphosphate diphosphatase
steps.note: Often handled by unspecific Nudix hydrolases; never penalized.

reasons: Pterin branch and FolP present, but p-aminobenzoate (pABA) synthesis is absent (pABA-dependent)

vitamins.name: Cobalamin / Cobamide
vitamins.summary: Most structurally complex vitamin, containing a cobalt-coordinated corrin ring. Synthesized via anaerobic or aerobic pathway, or salvaged from cobinamide and lower ligands.

steps.name: Uroporphyrinogen-III C-methyltransferase (CysG / CobA)
steps.note: Low specificity; shared with siroheme biosynthesis.

reasons: Lacks de novo corrin ring synthesis but retains nucleotide loop and salvage machinery (cobinamide salvager)
No B12-dependent enzymes (MetH, NrdJ, MutAB, EutBC, PduCDE, QueG) detected in genome

vitamins.name: Menaquinone
vitamins.summary: Lipophilic electron carrier in bacterial respiratory electron transport chains. Synthesized via classical chorismate/o-succinylbenzoate pathway or futalosine pathways.

steps.name: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoyl-CoA hydrolase (MenI)
steps.note: Replaced by thioesterases in many bacteria; never penalized.

reasons: No menaquinone pathway detected; organism likely utilizes ubiquinone, plastoquinone, or ferredoxin-based non-respiratory energy metabolism.
